description: Cross-exchange perpetuals board, read in bulk straight from Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid's public APIs (exchange-direct, no aggregator): for every crypto perp, each venue's current funding rate (% per 8h and annualized, normalized across 1h/4h/8h settlement intervals), open interest (USD), 24h volume, mark price and premium to index, plus the coin's OI-weighted funding across venues, the funding spread between the highest and lowest venue, total OI and total volume. Use it to scan the whole market at once: the most crowded longs or shorts (sort funding_high / funding_low / funding_abs), cross-venue funding dislocations (sort spread), where open interest sits (sort oi) or a few named coins side by side ('symbols'). Stock, ETF and commodity perps are left out. Binance publishes open interest one symbol at a time, so its OI is read for its ~60 most traded perps only (absent elsewhere; the weighting then uses the venues that have it). A venue that fails is reported in 'venues' and left out of the rows. For one coin's funding history and percentile use funding_current; for its OI series derivatives_open_interest.

min_volume_usd.description: Without 'symbols': leave out coins whose 24h volume across venues is below this, USD. Default 1000000.

sort.description: Row order. oi (default): total open interest. volume: 24h volume. funding_high / funding_low: OI-weighted funding, highest or lowest first. funding_abs: furthest from zero. spread: largest gap between venues' funding.

symbols.description: Optional comma-separated coins, e.g. "BTC,ETH,SOL": only those rows, whatever their volume.

name: derivatives_board

asOfMs.description: When the board was read, Unix epoch milliseconds

fundingBasis.description: How venues were combined: weighted by OI where read, else a plain mean

fundingPer8hPct.description: Funding across venues, percent per 8h; positive means longs pay shorts

fundingSpreadPer8hPct.description: Highest venue rate minus lowest, percent per 8h; absent with one venue

markPriceUsd.description: Median of the venues' mark prices, USD per coin

openInterestUsd.description: Sum over venues whose OI was read, USD; absent when none was

openInterestVenues.description: Venues whose OI is in the sum

fundingPer8hPct.description: The venue's current rate, percent per 8h (normalized from its own interval)

openInterestUsd.description: USD; absent where not read (Binance beyond its ~60 most traded)

matched.description: Coins that matched the filter before 'limit'

notListed.description: Requested symbols no answering venue lists

source.description: Always exchange-direct: the venues' own public APIs, no aggregator

error.description: Why the venue failed; absent when ok

title: Derivatives Board
